nodes.title: The Question Paper will have 75 questions.

nodes.label: ii
nodes.title: All questions will be based on Subject-Specific Knowledge.
Physics
nodes.body: Properties of Matter, Equations of motion, Gravitation, Keplers laws, Heat and Thermodynamics, Electrodynamics, Optics, Modern Physics and Laws of Radiation.

nodes.title: Mathematics
nodes.body: Ordinary differential equation and their solution, determinants and matrices (Fundamentals), Fourier series, Laplace Transform, Conic Section, Set Theory and Complex Variables.

nodes.title: Statistics
nodes.body: Measures of central tendency, dispersion. Significance tests and linear correlation.

nodes.title: Computer Science
nodes.body: Fundamentals of Computer, computer architecture, operating systems, Database Management System, Foundation of programming.

nodes.title: Earth & Environment
nodes.body: Earth Interior, Distribution of oceans and continents, composition and structure of atmosphere, world climate and climate change, physical environment, Environmental Pollution and its abatement, Environmental Awareness.
